_comment: One tab per daily check in Book 15, Chapter 12, with the domain controllers of Book 12, Chapter 03 (the cadence table's Daily rows and the by-family table's Daily column). kind 'workbook' tabs query the Sentinel Log Analytics workspace; 'link-out' tabs send the operator to the built-in portal page where the data isn't in Log Analytics. Tables, columns and GCC availability were read on Microsoft Learn on November 18 and 19, 2026 (the guide's verification log). Freshness limits and look-backs are design guidance: set each from the source's own cadence. render is the rule Invoke-DcRender.ps1 applies to fixture query results; it never makes the view evidence.
banner: This workbook is a view, not evidence. The evidence is the stored record each check writes and the tracked task each finding opens.

parameters.name: Workspace
parameters.purpose: The Sentinel Log Analytics workspace every query reads

parameters.name: EmergencyAccessIds
parameters.purpose: The emergency access accounts' object IDs, quoted and comma-separated

parameters.name: CompliantStateValue
parameters.purpose: The ComplianceState value your workspace records for a compliant device

parameters.name: DlpProductNames
parameters.purpose: The ProductName values of DLP and label alerts in SecurityAlert, quoted and comma-separated

parameters.name: ItsmQueueUrl
parameters.purpose: The ITSM tool's own queue page for catalog and remediation tasks

parameters.name: SyncServers
parameters.purpose: The Entra Connect Sync servers (active and staging), quoted and comma-separated, as the workspace's Computer column records them

parameters.name: SyncEventSources
parameters.purpose: The Application-log Source values of the synchronization service's events on those servers, quoted and comma-separated

parameters.name: BackupEventSources
parameters.purpose: The Source values of the nightly server backup's events on those servers, quoted and comma-separated

parameters.name: DomainControllers
parameters.purpose: The domain controllers, quoted and comma-separated, as the workspace's Computer column records them

parameters.name: IdentityAlertProductNames
parameters.purpose: The ProductName values of Defender for Identity alerts in SecurityAlert, quoted and comma-separated

tabs.title: Telemetry completeness
tabs.check: Telemetry-completeness check, network sources included (cadence table, Daily; by-family table, Network)

queries.title: Every expected table and the age of its newest record
Connectors whose latest SentinelHealth status is Failure

linkOuts.name: Sentinel Data collection health monitoring workbook
linkOuts.path: Microsoft Sentinel > Threat management > Workbooks > Templates > Data collection health monitoring

tabs.gcc: Available: the workspace is in commercial Azure, where Sentinel workbooks are GA. The Defender portal's Data & connectors Overview tab is a commercial-cloud preview and isn't used.
tabs.action: Each dark source opens a high-severity task; the completeness alert rule, not this tab, is the record.

tabs.title: Synchronization probe
tabs.check: Synchronization and service-health probe (task 6, the morning synchronization check), with the synchronization servers' own errors and backup result

queries.title: Errors and warnings the synchronization servers logged in the last day
Each synchronization server: its agent's last heartbeat and its latest backup event

linkOuts.name: Microsoft Entra Connect Health
linkOuts.path: Microsoft Entra Connect Health (left menu: Microsoft Entra Connect Sync)

tabs.gcc: The Logs Ingestion API that writes the probe's table, and the Azure Monitor Agent that sends the servers' Windows event logs to the Event table and their heartbeat to Heartbeat, are in commercial Azure; the servers must be Azure Arc-enabled. The synchronization service's event IDs are not yet specified on Learn: the settings name its event sources. Connect Health's GCC availability is not yet specified.
tabs.action: A drift verdict, a missed probe, a server error, a silent agent or a failed or missing backup opens a task; the probe's stored result and the servers' forwarded events are the record.

tabs.title: Active Directory
tabs.check: Domain controllers while they remain Tier 0 (Book 12, Chapter 03): agents reporting, replication, the High-rated security events, directory, SYSVOL and DNS errors, and Defender for Identity alerts (task 7, event-log handling; cadence table, log review findings)

queries.title: Each domain controller and when its agent last reported
Replication links from the probe's latest run
High-rated security events on the domain controllers in the last day
Directory, SYSVOL replication and DNS errors on the domain controllers in the last day
Defender for Identity alerts in the last day

linkOuts.name: Microsoft Entra Connect Health for AD DS
linkOuts.path: Microsoft Entra Connect Health (left menu: Active Directory Domain Services)

tabs.gcc: Available for the workspace tables: the Azure Monitor Agent on Azure Arc-enabled domain controllers (Event, Heartbeat), the Windows Security Events via AMA connector (SecurityEvent) and the Logs Ingestion API (the replication probe) are in commercial Azure, and Defender for Identity alerts in SecurityAlert are GA for GCC. Defender for Identity needs its own license. Connect Health's GCC availability is not yet specified: it stays a link-out.
tabs.action: A silent domain controller, a failing replication link or any High-rated event opens a high-severity task in the incident path; the forwarded events and the probe's stored result are the record.

tabs.title: Entra Health alerts

linkOuts.name: Microsoft Entra Health
linkOuts.path: Entra ID > Monitoring & health > Health > Health Monitoring

tabs.gcc: Not yet specified. Health monitoring is a preview shown in the admin center, by e-mail and through Graph beta; it isn't in Log Analytics.
tabs.action: Each active alert opens a task; dismissing one is a closure with its reason.

queries.title: Users at medium or high risk

linkOuts.path: ID Protection > Risky activities > Risky users

tabs.gcc: Available: Entra diagnostic settings send RiskyUsers and SignInLogs to the commercial workspace.
tabs.action: Each user at risk is triaged in the incident path; the triage record is the evidence.

queries.title: Sign-ins by the emergency access accounts

tabs.gcc: Available. The Azure Monitor alert rule on these sign-ins is the control; this tab only shows them.
tabs.action: Any row is reviewed as a drill, a real emergency or misuse, and the review is recorded.

tabs.title: Noncompliant devices

queries.title: Devices not compliant in the latest daily export

tabs.gcc: Available: Intune in GCC is the commercial service instance, and its diagnostic settings send DeviceComplianceOrg to the workspace.
tabs.action: The queue is worked in Intune and the ITSM tool; the export arrives once a day, up to 48 hours late.

tabs.title: Consents, roles and grants

linkOuts.name: Entra audit logs
linkOuts.path: Entra ID > Monitoring & health > Audit logs

tabs.gcc: Available. The match to a ticket isn't in the workbook: the ticket data stays in the ITSM tool.
tabs.action: Each row is matched to its ticket in the ITSM tool; a grant with no ticket opens a finding.

tabs.check: Request-driven admin changes matched to their tickets: password resets, authentication-method changes, accounts created, users updated by catalog scripts, custom role definitions (tasks 1 to 5 and 8; cadence table, catalog and remediation tasks), and Azure role assignments

Azure role assignments and custom role definitions written in the last day

The match to a ticket isn't in the workbook: the ticket data stays in the ITSM tool. Consents and Entra role assignments are on the Consents, roles and grants tab, not repeated here.
